ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NPP_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Incorrect Account Details"), Transaction_Type__c = 'TRANSACTION_TYPE_BSB_ACC_NUM', OR( ISBLANK(Description), ISBLANK(Intended_Account_BSB__c), ISBLANK(Intended_Account_Name__c), ISBLANK(Intended_Account_Number__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Description of Issue, Intended Account BSB, Intended Account Name, Intended Account Number.
